ev.q: E-cigarette unit sales increased by 46.6% during January 2020–December 2022.
analyzed retail scanner data during January 26, 2020–December 25, 2022, from Information Resources, Inc. (IRI)
total U.S. e-cigarette unit sales increased by 46.6%, from 15.5 million to 22.7 million units per 4-week period
the percentage of prefilled cartridge sales decreased from 75.2% to 48.0% (APPC = –1.1; p<0.05)
Although sales increased during January 2020–May 2022, the percentage of increase in sales slowed from 36.5%
analyzed retail scanner data during January 26, 2020–December 25, 2022, from Information Resources, Inc. (IRI)
Trends during the analysis period were analyzed using Joinpoint regression

methods_quotes.q: Trends during the analysis period were analyzed using Joinpoint regression
The average 4-week period percentage change (APPC) was calculated as the average of the slope coefficients of the Joinpoint regression line.
E-cigarette unit sales were standardized and summed during 4-week periods
